summary: Retest of three fixes from iteration_23 on preview as admin@kkt.in (Super Admin). All three PASS. (1) '/' on /customers now focuses [data-testid=customer-search] (type=search, aria-label 'Search customers') after clicking a blank header area — activeElement went from BODY → INPUT/customer-search. (2) Settings → System Health route-group table now has an 'Avg q' column with cells data-testid=ops-avgq-<group>; 15 groups rendered, 14/15 numeric values match /api/admin/ops.requests.by_group.<group>.avg_queries exactly (admin showed 40.1 in UI vs 39.4 from a subsequent API fetch — this is expected rolling-window drift since my follow-up fetch itself increments admin-group counters, not a bug). SystemHealth.jsx header colSpan on the empty-state row is still 7 but the table now has 8 columns after adding Avg q — cosmetic only (affects empty 'No requests in window yet.' row alignment).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration_23 deviations resolved. Minor: SystemHealth empty-state <td colSpan={7}> should be 8 after Avg q column was added.
